name: Archer
protection: Armoured cab. Game: light armour on cab/turret only; immune to small-calibre rounds, 7.62x54R and larger disable it; launchers destroy it.
visual_notes: Volvo A30D 6x6 articulated dump-truck chassis: armoured cab on front unit, gun on rear unit
155 mm barrel travels lying forward over the cab and is covered/stowed in a cradle
Automatic magazine in the rear body; roof RWS on the cab
Large rear stabiliser legs lowered when firing
Articulated 6x6 hauler with an armoured cab and a covered 155 mm gun on the rear unit
